newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to May 18.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to May 18
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
MONDAY, APRIL 21
LONDON - Electronic Programme Guides: The Gateway to Next Generation Television, Le Meridien Hotel. Contact: (44) 171-453-2700 or (44) 171-637-4383. (three-day conference, April 21-23)
LONDON - Cable & Satellite 97, Earls Court 2. Contact: (44) 01203 426484. Web site: http://www.cabsat.co.uk (three-day conference, April 21-23).

LONDON - Television Distribution Technology 97, in conjunction with Cable & Satellite 97 exhibition, Earls Court International Hotel. Contact: (44) 171 637 4383 or (44) 171 453 2700. (three-day exhibition, April 21-23).
TUESDAY, APRIL 22
LONDON - Electronic Programme Guides: The Gateway to Next Generation Television, Le Meridien Hotel. (three-day conference, April 21-23)
LONDON - Cable & Satellite 97, Earls Court 2 (three-day conference, April 21-23).
LONDON - Television Distribution Technology 97, Earls Court International Hotel (three-day exhibition, April 21-23).
LONDON - UK Internet Show '97, Earls Court. Contact: (44) 181 390 2027 or http://www.ukinternetshhow.com. (three-day exhibition, April 22-24).
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 23
LONDON - Electronic Programme Guides: The Gateway to Next Generation Television, Marriott Hotel. (three-day conference, note different location for this the last day).

LONDON - Cable & Satellite 97, Earls Court 2 (three-day conference, April 21-23).
LONDON - Television Distribution Technology 97 (three-day exhibition, April 21-23).
LONDON - UK Internet Show '97, Earls Court. (three-day exhibition, April 22-24).
LONDON - The Marketer's Guide to Driving Loyalty. Royal Aeronautical Society, 4 Hamilton Place, Hyde Park Corner. Contact: (44) 171 838 0008.

LONDON - European Internet Service Provision Congress. Pricing, Marketing, Technology and Competitive Issues Congress. Hilton London Olympia Hotel. Contact: (44) 171 421 3500. (two-day conference April 23-24).

BRUSSELS - DMA/EDMA Success@WWW Seminar, Pre-Forum Internet marketing seminar ahead of two-day forum of European Direct Marketing Association. Management Centre Europe, rue de l'Aqueduc, 118 B-1050 Brussels. Contact: (32) 2 779 42 68.
